assertions.name: server-health-200
args: const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5217/api/health'); if (response.status !== 200) { console.error(response.status); process.exit(1); }

assertions.name: public-homepage-200
args: const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5217/'); if (response.status !== 200) { console.error(response.status); process.exit(1); }

assertions.name: login-page-200
args: const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5217/login'); if (response.status !== 200) { console.error(response.status); process.exit(1); }

assertions.name: protected-dashboard-redirect
args: const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5217/dashboard', { redirect: 'manual' }); if (response.status !== 302 || response.headers.get('location') !== '/login?next=%2Fdashboard') { console.error(response.status, response.headers.get('location')); process.exit(1); }

args: const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5217/boss-nana', { redirect: 'manual' }); if (response.status !== 302 || response.headers.get('location') !== '/login?next=%2Fboss-nana') { console.error(response.status, response.headers.get('location')); process.exit(1); }
